A.name: Binary Basic
A.description: Standard binary shift-register receiver with 10-bit codes.

B.name: Trinary
B.description: Trinary shift-register receiver using 3-symbol alphabet (0,1,2) with 7-symbol codes.

C.name: Binary OOK-Encoded
C.description: Binary receiver with OOK physical encoding. Each logical symbol maps to a 4-bit physical pattern. Provide encoded physical bits in the sequence file.

D.name: Quaternary
D.description: Quaternary shift-register receiver using 4-symbol alphabet (0,1,2,3) with 5-symbol codes.

E.name: Multi-Length Binary
E.description: Five binary shift-register receivers monitoring the same bitstream simultaneously, with code lengths 8 through 12. A single sequence must crack all five receivers.
